versions.changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md references from "腾讯云" (Tencent Cloud) to generic "云服务器" (cloud server)
- Adjusted deployment and configuration instructions to use generic cloud server terminology

Initial release of openclaw-aligenie-genie.

- Enables bidirectional communication between OpenClaw Agent and Tmall Genie via Tencent Cloud.
- Supports registering and maintaining connection with Tmall Genie.
- Provides Python client and configuration instructions for agent integration.
- Includes technical specs, deployment guide, and quick-start guide.
